listing.name: Sin & Punishment Recompiled
listing.summary: Explore Sin & Punishment Recompiled and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Understand the current development limit
steps.instruction: Upstream’s current milestone reaches the native title screen; gameplay/runtime completion remains in progress and no player package is published. Its public build guide also requires rom/sinpunishment_patched.z64 and a working-image patch pipeline that is not published. Your clean Japanese ROM and a clean clone alone do not establish a reproducible game build. Keep using an existing prepared development copy if you have one, preserving its files and limitations; do not select N64Recomp/RSPRecomp compiler tools as the player.

steps.title: Keep your files and update through upstream
steps.instruction: Keep any existing prepared development copy in a separate folder you control. Portcove can retain a non-owning registration of that runtime after read-only executable review; launching remains a separate explicit action. You or upstream keep its updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings. Portcove does not supply a playable package, replace this runtime, or back it up or roll it back.
